entries.en: Half the sandwich remained uneaten on the plate.
entries.zh: 盘子里还剩着半个没吃的三明治。

entries.en: The director used the talkback to speak to the camera crew.
entries.zh: 导演通过对讲系统与摄像组交谈。

entries.en: The villagers feared the undead lurking beyond the ruined gate.
entries.zh: 村民害怕潜伏在残破城门外的亡灵。

entries.en: The specialist examined an image of the cholesteatoma.
entries.zh: 专科医生查看了胆脂瘤的影像。

entries.en: The micrograph revealed tiny cracks along the metal surface.
entries.zh: 显微照片显示金属表面有细小裂纹。

entries.en: They shared a bottle of Chianti with their evening meal.
entries.zh: 他们晚餐时分饮了一瓶基安蒂红葡萄酒。

entries.en: The student plotted the wavefunction for the simplified model.
entries.zh: 学生画出了简化模型的波函数。

entries.en: The researcher tracked a single nanoparticle through the liquid.
entries.zh: 研究者追踪了一颗纳米粒子在液体中的运动。

entries.en: The videographer recorded interviews for the television documentary.
entries.zh: 录像制作人为电视纪录片录制了访谈。

entries.en: The lander's camera sent back images of the rocky moonscape.
entries.zh: 着陆器上的相机传回了岩石遍布的月球表面影像。

entries.en: The chart gives the observed intensity in units of one rayleigh.
entries.zh: 图表以一瑞利为单位列出了观测到的发光强度。

entries.en: A pink waterlily opened beside the pond's stone edge.
entries.zh: 一朵粉色睡莲在池塘的石岸边绽放。

entries.en: A sanitarian inspected the kitchen before the restaurant reopened.
entries.zh: 餐厅重新营业前，一位公共卫生专家检查了厨房。

entries.en: The simulation compares two kinematic models of the robot arm.
entries.zh: 这项模拟比较了机械臂的两个运动学模型。

entries.en: The new single received considerable airplay on local radio.
entries.zh: 这首新单曲在当地电台获得了大量播放。

entries.en: She slowly began to unclench her fists.
entries.zh: 她开始慢慢松开拳头。

entries.en: The fraudster vanished after collecting money from the investors.
entries.zh: 诈骗者收取投资者的钱后就消失了。

entries.en: The orchestra placed its stringed instruments near the front.
entries.zh: 乐团把弦乐器安排在前排附近。

entries.en: The diagram illustrates convective heat transfer inside the container.
entries.zh: 图示展示了容器内通过对流传热的过程。

entries.en: The engineer calculated radiative heat loss from the hot surface.
entries.zh: 工程师计算了高温表面的辐射热损失。

entries.en: An ambulanceman helped the injured cyclist onto a stretcher.
entries.zh: 一名救护人员帮助受伤的骑车人躺上担架。

entries.en: The second examination revealed that the original assessment was a misdiagnosis.
entries.zh: 第二次检查表明，最初的判断是一次误诊。

entries.en: The old curtains were discolored after years in direct sunlight.
entries.zh: 旧窗帘在阳光下直晒多年后褪色了。

entries.en: His cellmate lent him a paperback to read.
entries.zh: 他的同牢室友借给他一本平装书读。

entries.en: Snow covered the highest peaks of the cordillera.
entries.zh: 积雪覆盖了这片连绵山脉的最高峰。

entries.en: Small birds searched the mudflat for food at low tide.
entries.zh: 退潮时，小鸟在泥滩上觅食。

entries.en: The system recorded a failed logon during the night.
entries.zh: 系统记录了夜间的一次登录失败。

entries.en: The technician observed bacilli under the microscope.
entries.zh: 技术员在显微镜下观察到了杆菌。

entries.en: The editor replaced the long headline with a punchy phrase.
entries.zh: 编辑用一个有力的短语替换了冗长的标题。

entries.en: The mechanic checked the racecar before the final practice session.
entries.zh: 最后一次练习赛前，机械师检查了赛车。

entries.en: The analysis accounts for seasonality in hotel bookings.
entries.zh: 这项分析考虑了酒店预订的季节性。

entries.en: The historian studied dueling among officers in the old regiment.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了旧时该军团军官之间的决斗。

entries.en: The proposal aims to depoliticize appointments to the board.
entries.zh: 这项提议旨在使董事会的人事任命非政治化。

entries.en: Visitors must report to the office before entering the worksite.
entries.zh: 访客进入工地前必须到办公室报到。

entries.en: The estate records list a horse received as heriot.
entries.zh: 庄园档案记载了一匹作为佃户死后贡物收取的马。

entries.en: The historian examined the role of airpower in the campaign.
entries.zh: 历史学家考察了空中力量在这场战役中的作用。

entries.en: The laboratory identified a radionuclide in the sample.
entries.zh: 实验室在样本中鉴定出了一种放射性核素。

entries.en: A Kazakh on the tour translated the conversation for us.
entries.zh: 同行的一位哈萨克人为我们翻译了谈话。

entries.en: The researchers will disaggregate the results by age group.
entries.zh: 研究者将按年龄组分解这些结果。

entries.en: She grated Romano over the steaming pasta.
entries.zh: 她把罗马诺干酪磨碎，撒在热气腾腾的意面上。

entries.en: A monsignor welcomed the visitors at the church entrance.
entries.zh: 一位蒙席神父在教堂入口迎接访客。

entries.en: Please wear your nametag where visitors can see it.
entries.zh: 请把姓名牌佩戴在访客能看见的位置。

entries.en: The survey measured growth in nonagricultural employment.
entries.zh: 调查测量了非农业就业的增长情况。

entries.en: The stuntman rehearsed the fall onto a padded platform.
entries.zh: 特技替身演员排练了跌落到软垫平台上的动作。

entries.en: The mapmaker checked the coastline against recent aerial photographs.
entries.zh: 制图师对照近期航拍照片核查了海岸线。

entries.en: Please reinsert the card after the light turns green.
entries.zh: 指示灯变绿后，请重新插入卡片。

entries.en: An old shipman told stories beside the harbor wall.
entries.zh: 一位老水手在港口围墙旁讲故事。

entries.en: Several unburned logs remained beneath the ashes.
entries.zh: 灰烬下面还留着几根未燃烧的木柴。

entries.en: The gallery displayed pottery decorated with Ephesian designs.
entries.zh: 画廊展出了带有以弗所图案的陶器。

entries.en: The guard passed the ball into the frontcourt.
entries.zh: 后卫把球传到了前场。

entries.en: The article examines inculturation through the use of local languages.
entries.zh: 文章通过当地语言的使用考察本地文化适应。

entries.en: The doctor reviewed the laparoscopic images with a colleague.
entries.zh: 医生与同事一起查看了腹腔镜检查影像。

entries.en: Her essay contrasts practical reform with utopianism.
entries.zh: 她的文章对比了实际改革与乌托邦思想。

entries.en: The cyclist performed a wheelie on the empty practice track.
entries.zh: 骑车人在空旷的练习道上表演了抬前轮特技。

entries.en: The boilermaker inspected the steel seams before starting repairs.
entries.zh: 锅炉修造工在开始维修前检查了钢材接缝。

entries.en: The report noted the overrepresentation of large firms in the sample.
entries.zh: 报告指出，样本中大公司的比例过高。

entries.en: The design students gathered for a crit of their latest models.
entries.zh: 设计专业学生聚在一起，对最新的模型进行评讲。

entries.en: A narrow footway runs beside the canal.
entries.zh: 一条狭窄的人行道沿运河延伸。

entries.en: The tiled backsplash protects the wall behind the stove.
entries.zh: 铺有瓷砖的防溅挡板保护着炉灶后面的墙面。

entries.en: She drew a rough map on the whiteboard.
entries.zh: 她在白板上画了一张简略地图。

entries.en: The model describes energy exchanged in discrete quanta.
entries.zh: 这个模型描述了以离散量子形式交换的能量。

entries.en: The technician examined a sample of Magnox under magnification.
entries.zh: 技术员放大观察了一块镁诺克斯合金样品。

entries.en: The front row offers more legroom than the seats behind it.
entries.zh: 前排的腿部空间比后面的座位更大。

entries.en: He rinsed his wetsuit after the morning dive.
entries.zh: 他在早晨潜水后冲洗了湿式潜水服。

entries.en: The office introduced a paperless system for expense claims.
entries.zh: 办公室引入了无纸化报销系统。

entries.en: The technician added water to rehydrate the dried sample.
entries.zh: 技术员加水，使干燥样本重新水化。

entries.en: The portrait shows a hidalgo wearing a dark velvet coat.
entries.zh: 肖像中是一位身穿深色天鹅绒外套的西班牙贵族。

entries.en: The agreement created tradable permits for the participating firms.
entries.zh: 这项协议为参与公司创设了可交易的许可证。

entries.en: The engineer inspected the coker during the scheduled shutdown.
entries.zh: 工程师在计划停工期间检查了炼焦器。

entries.en: She put a raincoat and lunch in her daypack.
entries.zh: 她把雨衣和午饭装进小背包。

entries.en: The company gave us the runaround instead of processing the refund.
entries.zh: 公司一直对我们推诿，没有办理退款。

entries.en: Preproduction exposed several faults before the factory expanded its output.
entries.zh: 试验性生产在工厂扩大产量前暴露了几处缺陷。

entries.en: He stored the cigars in a wooden humidor.
entries.zh: 他把雪茄存放在木制保湿盒里。

entries.en: The doomsayer predicted disaster whenever the council proposed a change.
entries.zh: 市议会每次提出改革，这位凶事预言者都会预言灾难。

entries.en: Workers replaced the damaged ductwork above the ceiling.
entries.zh: 工人更换了天花板上方损坏的管道系统。

entries.en: The wicketkeeper caught the ball just behind the stumps.
entries.zh: 板球守门员在三柱门后方接住了球。

entries.en: The voyageur guided his canoe through the narrow channel.
entries.zh: 这位加拿大船夫驾着独木舟穿过狭窄水道。

entries.en: The background music affected her mood subliminally.
entries.zh: 背景音乐在下意识中影响了她的心情。

entries.en: Families gathered along the prado for an evening stroll.
entries.zh: 一家家人在林荫大道上聚集，准备傍晚散步。

entries.en: The diagram shows a superset containing both smaller sets.
entries.zh: 图中显示了一个包含两个较小集合的超集。

entries.en: The researchers collected a bioaerosol sample near the ventilation outlet.
entries.zh: 研究者在通风口附近采集了一份生物气溶胶样本。

entries.en: She brushed a little bronzer across her cheeks.
entries.zh: 她在双颊轻扫了一点古铜色化妆品。

entries.en: He answered chillingly and turned away without another word.
entries.zh: 他冷淡地回答了一句，随后转身离去，没再说话。

entries.en: Snow filled the steep couloir between the rocky peaks.
entries.zh: 积雪填满了岩石山峰间陡峭的峡谷。

entries.en: The tailor showed her a sample of lovat.
entries.zh: 裁缝给她看了一块杂绿色的布样。

entries.en: A bluesy guitar solo filled the small club.
entries.zh: 一段布鲁斯风格的吉他独奏响彻小俱乐部。

entries.en: The orchestra opened the concert with a short sinfonia.
entries.zh: 乐团以一首短小的交响乐曲拉开音乐会序幕。

entries.en: The teacher asked us to identify an uncountable noun.
entries.zh: 老师让我们找出一个不可数名词。

entries.en: The study offers a typological comparison of several languages.
entries.zh: 这项研究对几种语言进行了类型学比较。

entries.en: The operator adjusted the seamer before stitching the fabric.
entries.zh: 操作员在缝合布料前调整了缝纫机。

entries.en: We stopped for lunch beside a quiet lochan.
entries.zh: 我们在一个宁静的小湖旁停下来吃午饭。

entries.en: A majoritarian defended the decision as the will of most voters.
entries.zh: 一位多数主义者为该决定辩护，称它体现了大多数选民的意愿。

entries.en: He grew twitchy as the interview time approached.
entries.zh: 面试时间临近时，他变得焦躁不安。

entries.en: The red supercar attracted a crowd outside the hotel.
entries.zh: 那辆红色超级跑车在酒店外吸引了一群人。

entries.en: By accepting the keys, she impliedly agreed to the arrangement.
entries.zh: 她接过钥匙，就隐含地同意了这项安排。

entries.en: The geologist compared stratigraphic records from the two valleys.
entries.zh: 地质学家比较了两个山谷的地层学记录。

entries.en: The mirror has a beveled edge that catches the light.
entries.zh: 镜子的斜边能映出光线。

entries.en: The collection includes fossils from Silurian rocks.
entries.zh: 藏品中包括来自志留纪岩层的化石。

entries.en: A Dubliner recommended a quiet cafe near the river.
entries.zh: 一位都柏林人推荐了河边一家安静的咖啡馆。

entries.en: The survey documented housing conditions in the colonia.
entries.zh: 这项调查记录了该墨西哥裔美国人社区的住房状况。

entries.en: The merger brought a diminishment of her responsibilities.
entries.zh: 合并导致她的职责范围缩小。

entries.en: The company hired a designer from its archrival.
entries.zh: 公司从主要竞争对手那里聘来一位设计师。

entries.en: The children watched the pupae inside the transparent enclosure.
entries.zh: 孩子们观察透明围箱里的蛹。

entries.en: The society announced plans for its quadrennial conference.
entries.zh: 协会公布了每四年一次的大会的筹备计划。

entries.en: The laboratory tested the water sample for cryptosporidium.
entries.zh: 实验室检测水样中是否含有隐孢子虫。

entries.en: The secondee joined our department for a six-month assignment.
entries.zh: 这位借调员工到我们部门任职六个月。

entries.en: The team modeled the atmosphere of a distant exoplanet.
entries.zh: 团队模拟了一颗遥远外星球的大气层。

entries.en: The ticket includes a small nonrefundable booking fee.
entries.zh: 票价中包含一小笔不可退还的预订费。

entries.en: The memoir describes a former druggie rebuilding his family relationships.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录讲述了一位前吸毒者重建家庭关系的经历。

entries.en: She placed a woven placemat beneath each plate.
entries.zh: 她在每个盘子下面放了一张编织餐具垫。

entries.en: We ate grilled fish at a taverna near the harbor.
entries.zh: 我们在港口附近的一家希腊小酒馆吃了烤鱼。

entries.en: Her whispery voice was barely audible above the rain.
entries.zh: 雨声中，她轻柔低低的声音几乎听不见。

entries.en: Loose stones rolled downslope after the climber passed.
entries.zh: 登山者经过后，松石向坡下滚落。

entries.en: He begrudgingly agreed to help clean the kitchen.
entries.zh: 他勉强答应帮忙打扫厨房。

entries.en: The gangbuster interviewed witnesses from the neighborhood.
entries.zh: 这位打击帮派的执法人员询问了街区里的目击者。

entries.en: His sophomoric jokes annoyed the other committee members.
entries.zh: 他那些幼稚而自大的笑话惹恼了其他委员会成员。

entries.en: The coach still believed the match was winnable.
entries.zh: 教练仍然相信这场比赛能够获胜。

entries.en: She wiped the lenses with a microfiber cloth.
entries.zh: 她用微纤维布擦拭镜片。

entries.en: The lecture compared interventionism with a policy of minimal regulation.
entries.zh: 这场讲座比较了干预主义与最低限度监管政策。

entries.en: The blast sent a shockwave through the empty valley.
entries.zh: 爆炸向空旷的山谷中发出了一道冲击波。

entries.en: The inquiry found no evidence of his privity in the scheme.
entries.zh: 调查没有发现他私下知悉该计划的证据。

entries.en: She packed a bento for the train journey.
entries.zh: 她为火车旅行准备了一份日式盒饭。

entries.en: The coastguard received a mayday from a fishing boat.
entries.zh: 海岸警卫队收到了一艘渔船发出的遇险求救信号。
